correspondences.notes: One BIDS mask per ROI with label-; label.json has no BIDS equivalent.

brainlife.desc: Directory of binary NIfTI ROI masks (0/1), one region per file, with optional label.json naming each ROI.
brainlife.name: neuro/rois

original.desc: Regions of interests in multiple nifti files. Each nifti files should be a binary masks (values should be either 0 or 1)

file_descs.label: (optional) json file containing list of object that describes each roi stored in rois directory. This information will be used by brainlife UI to present a user dropdown list of existing ROIs within a data object.
file_descs.rois: A directory containing some number of .nii.gz files representing ROI s (binary mask)

original.readme:
label.json should look like this

```
[
    {
        "filename": "ROI1001.nii.gz", 
        "name": "XYZ1 region of the MNI305 atlas",
        "id": "1001",
        "atlas": "MN305", (optional)
        "color": "#345" (optional)
    },
    {
        "filename": "ROI1002.nii.gz", 
        "name": "XYZ2 region of the MNI305 atlas",
        "id": "1002",
        "atlas": "MN305",
        "color": "#456"
    }
    ...
]
```
